caption: A top-down photo of a bowl of Japanese ramen with clear pale golden shio (salt) broth. Wheat noodles are submerged in the broth, topped with nori seaweed, sliced chashu pork, bamboo shoots, fish cake. The bowl sits on a table, shot in warm natural light, appetizing food photography.

segments_info.text: The table surface behind the ramen bowl, softly out of focus.
A slice of chashu pork with a soft fat rim and browned white surface.
A sheet of dried nori seaweed, dark and slightly glossy, standing in the soup.
The clear pale golden shio (salt) broth, with wheat noodles just under the surface.
Strips of menma, pale yellow-brown fermented bamboo shoots.
A ceramic ramen bowl seen from above, its glazed rim catching the light.
A slice of naruto fish cake, white with a pink spiral pattern.
